🚀 Langostino | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a complete, open-source reference implementation for building and operating autonomous drones powered by AI and ROS2, enabling users to understand, extend, and deploy drone autonomy.
✨ Key Features: • Open-source autonomous flight platform • ROS2 integration • AI-powered flight control • Reference implementation for drone autonomy • Community-driven development
📖 Summary: Langostino is an open-source autonomous drone platform utilizing ROS2 and AI for advanced flight control. It serves as a comprehensive reference implementation for developing, understanding, and extending drone autonomy, enabling users to build and fly their own AI-powered drones.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 File_Converter_Pro | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a free, private, and comprehensive offline tool for converting various file types on Windows.
✨ Key Features: • All-in-one file conversion (documents, images, audio, video) • 100% offline and private operation • Batch conversion support • Statistics dashboard and gamified achievements
📖 Summary: File Converter Pro is a free, offline, all-in-one file conversion application for Windows. It supports documents, images, audio, and video, operating entirely locally without internet access or dependencies. The application features a polished user interface with dark/light themes, a statistics dashboard, and gamified achievements.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 netwatch | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide real-time, in-depth network diagnostics and security monitoring directly within the terminal for network professionals, incident responders, and system administrators.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time network monitoring in the terminal
📖 Summary: NetWatch is a real-time network diagnostics tool that runs in the terminal. It provides instant visibility into network activity, decodes encrypted traffic, identifies processes behind connections, and detects potential threats like malware beaconing or data exfiltration over DNS. It aims to consolidate the functionality of bandwidth meters, Wireshark triage views, and intrusion detectors into a single, zero-configuration binary.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 FreeToken | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Running large-scale AI models locally on personal computers and consumer hardware with high performance.
✨ Key Features: • Fast Edge-Native Runtime with bandwidth-adaptive CPU–GPU co-execution • Semantic-Aware Caching for recurrent state and KV caches • Elastic Memory Management for dynamic VRAM re-allocation • Broad MoE & Ecosystem Support for various models and quantization formats
📖 Summary: FreeToken is an edge-native serving engine designed to run large, frontier-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models efficiently on consumer hardware. It unifies heterogeneous edge resources like GPUs and CPUs into a single inference platform, enabling high-speed local execution of massive models.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 ai-copywriter | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To generate human-sounding, effective marketing copy that converts by understanding the target audience's emotions and simplifying complex concepts.
✨ Key Features: • Writes attention-grabbing copy (clickbait titles, short descriptions, microcopy, subject lines) • Removes AI-generated writing patterns for a human tone • Built on blader's Humanizer for AI pattern detection and correction
📖 Summary: This AI copywriter is a Python-based agent skill that generates compelling marketing copy, such as headlines and product descriptions, while ensuring it reads naturally and avoids AI detection. It achieves this by integrating real copywriting techniques and marketing knowledge, focusing on the reader's emotions and simplifying explanations.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
